description: This file defines a React component ErrorBoundary for catching runtime errors in React components, along with related type definitions, a remote logging function, and usage documentation.

classes.name: ErrorBoundary
classes.description: A React component class that implements an error boundary to catch and handle errors during rendering of React components.

methods.name: logErrorRemotely
methods.description: Asynchronous function to log error details remotely; defaults to console error but can be extended to send logs to a remote logging service.

methods.name: ErrorBoundary::getDerivedStateFromError
methods.description: Static method to update component state when an error is caught during rendering.

methods.name: ErrorBoundary::componentDidCatch
methods.description: Lifecycle method invoked after an error is caught; logs error details remotely and calls optional onError callback.

methods.name: ErrorBoundary::render
methods.description: Render method that displays either fallback UI on error or children components normally.
